request.questionText: This question assesses whether you're able to download and import a data set into R, load a library, and run a block of code. Download the data in microfi_households.csv. Follow the steps outlined in lessons 1 and 2 of our online course packet to: 1) Import the data set into R, saving the data set in an object called microfi_households. 2) Load the tidyverse library (which you'll need to install first if you haven't already). Then, type the commands below into a new script, and run the commands. It's not important that you understand what the commands are doing right now; (though you will soon understand!) The purpose of this exercise is to check whether everything is working on your end by running a block of code that produces known behavior. Then, verify that you arrive at the correct answer below. Below is the code for the commands to type and run in a RStudio script: microfi_households %>% filter(village == 46) %>% summarize(loan_prop = mean(loan)) %>% round(3) Upon running these commands, you should see a three-digit decimal number printed out under the word "loan_prop" in your console. What number do you see?
